decision.proof: Restrict public normalized199; derive state-zero reference towers by the public affine pullback; form exactly three products and two differences; identify the literal normalized discriminant by a polynomial identity.
decision.improvement_over_previous_outline: Use SmoothDirections.compAffine already imported through WeightedJointComposition. No extra CircleSmoothDirectionsOperations import is needed. The final identity needs neither a new sample bound nor division cancellation: rewrite division as multiplication by H inverse and use ring.
decision.compile_scope: This is a code-level proof plan, not an elaboration or compiled theorem. Only direct public API visibility and the listed exact source identities were checked; a final candidate import/name graph remains to be frozen with the future source.

proposed_public_header:
theorem N01Properties.exists_discriminantIncrement_strip_joint_growth
    {D : ReferenceData} {T : MaterialData} {S : PhysicalSpacesData}
    {C : NonlinearGeometryData S} {base loss : ℕ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (j : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hcell : ∀ m, Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ⊆ D.cells (j m))
    (l h : ℕ → ℝ) (hl : ∀ m, C.left m < l m)
    (hh : ∀ m, h m < C.right m) :
    ∃ K : ∀ m, SmoothDirections
      (sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε ×ˢ (Ioo (l m) (h m) ×ˢ univ))
      (fun z : (StateDirections S × ℝ) × PolarPoint =>
        (((originalCoefficients D S C (liftSectorParameter S C z.1)).b z.2 ^ 2 -
            (originalCoefficients D S C (liftSectorParameter S C z.1)).a z.2 *
              (originalCoefficients D S C (liftSectorParameter S C z.1)).c z.2) -
          ((originalCoefficients D S C (C.referenceState, 0)).b z.2 ^ 2 -
            (originalCoefficients D S C (C.referenceState, 0)).a z.2 *
              (originalCoefficients D S C (C.referenceState, 0)).c z.2)) /
          T.H (T.sample (j m)) ^ (3 / 4 : ℝ)),
      ∃ B L : ℕ, base ≤ B ∧ loss ≤ B ∧
        UniformWeightedJointGrowth (pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading)
          (fun m => radialE (D.cellIndex (j m))) K B L

common_data.V: fun m => Ioo (l m) (h m) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)
common_data.f: fun (i : Fin 3) (_m : ℕ) (z : E × PolarPoint) => originalCoefficientEntry D S C i (liftSectorParameter S C z.1) z.2
common_data.f0: fun (i : Fin 3) (_m : ℕ) (z : E × PolarPoint) => originalCoefficientEntry D S C i (C.referenceState, 0) z.2
common_data.di: fun (i : Fin 3) (m : ℕ) (z : E × PolarPoint) => (H m)⁻¹ * coefficientFamily D S C i 0 0 z.2 (liftSectorParameter S C z.1)
common_data.identity_convention: i=0 is a, i=1 is b, i=2 is c; all coefficients and the reference coefficient use the identical physical z.2. Setting the sector parameter to 0 gives exactly (C.referenceState,0). No C/R/L/χ/sample/domain selector is reselected.
common_data.domain_requirements: Only hcell, C.left<l and h<C.right are needed for this polynomial leaf. l<h need not be added: empty strips are allowed and all existing source constructors have the same contract.
common_data.positivity_not_assumed: No discriminant or a lower bound is used in this first polynomial leaf. The later inverse/sqrt leaf must use the actual closed-buffer lower bound from the same153 witness.

theorem N01Properties.originalCoefficient_strip_joint_growth
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)

    (j : ℕ → ℕ) (hcell : ∀ m, Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ⊆ D.cells (j m))

exact_public_inputs.original_speed_existence_header:
theorem N01Properties.exists_minusCharacteristicSpeed_strip_joint_growth
    (hN : N01Properties D T S C base loss ε)
    (hS : IsPhysicalSpaces D T S) (hT : IsMaterialData D T)
    (j : ℕ → ℕ) (hcell : ∀ m, Ioo (C.left m) (C.right m) ⊆ D.cells (j m))
    (l h : ℕ → ℝ) (hl : ∀ m, C.left m < l m) (hh : ∀ m, h m < C.right m)
    {lam P : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) (hP : 0 ≤ P)
    (hpositive : ∀ z ∈ stateNeighborhood S C base ε, ∀ (m : ℕ) (p : PolarPoint),
      p.1 ∈ Ioo (l m) (h m) →
      let d := lam * radialE (D.cellIndex (j m)) ^ (-P) / 2
      d ≤ (originalCoefficients D S C z).a p ∧
      d ^ 2 ≤ (originalCoefficients D S C z).b p ^ 2 -
        (originalCoefficients D S C z).a p * (originalCoefficients D S C z).c p) :
    ∃ K : ∀ m, SmoothDirections
        (sectorNeighborhood S base ε ε ×ˢ (Ioo (l m) (h m) ×ˢ univ))
        (fun x : (StateDirections S × ℝ) × PolarPoint =>
          minusCharacteristicSpeed (originalCoefficients D S C (liftSectorParameter S C x.1)) x.2),
      ∃ B L : ℕ, base ≤ B ∧ loss ≤ B ∧
        UniformWeightedJointGrowth (pairGrading (sectorGrading S) realGrading)
          (fun m => radialE (D.cellIndex (j m))) K B L

code_level_construction.title: Fix the grading, domains and actual current towers before any order.
code_level_construction.outline: Let Ji m := hN.originalCoefficient_stripTower hS hT j hcell l h hl hh i m. Set hp := sectorPairGrading_monotone S and obtain HasInterpolation p exactly as public b95 lines345–347. hW m := one_le_radialE_of_nat _. For each i, the exact originalCoefficient_strip_joint_growth gives Growth p 1 (Ji) base loss; .withWeight W gives the same base/loss with exponent0.
code_level_construction.no_target_input: No derivative bound is assumed beyond hN/hS/hT; the supplier is the public original-coefficient theorem.

code_level_construction.title: Construct reference towers by the actual zero-state continuous linear map.
code_level_construction.exact_maps: L0 (u,y)=(0,y), and L0(v_state,v_phys)=(0,v_phys). Use ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, _root_.zero_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_snd' rather than unfolding mathlib records.
code_level_construction.zero_domain: hN.2.1 is 0<ε from the actual N01 definition. Unfold only project sectorNeighborhood; map_zero and abs_zero show (0:E)∈U. simp [liftSectorParameter] gives liftSectorParameter S C 0=(C.referenceState,0).
code_level_construction.tower: For each i,m, take (Ji m).compAffine L0 0 ((sectorNeighborhood_isOpen S base ε ε).prod (isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_univ)) hmap and .congrOn to f0 i m. hmap sends (u,y) to (0,y); its physical point is unchanged.
code_level_construction.actual_jet_identity: The D layer of congrOn is unchanged. compAffine_apply gives (J0i m).D n (u,y) v=(Ji m).D n (0,y) (fun t => (0,(v t).2)) on the same U×V m. This also holds at n=0.

code_level_construction.title: Prove reference growth without changing the low base.
code_level_construction.outline: For each fixed i and n, call the original Growth p 1 Ji base loss with low radius 0, then state x=0. The input low bound is p base 0=0. If p base (v t).1+norm((v t).2)≤1, seminorm nonnegativity implies norm((v t).2)≤1, hence the pulled-back slot (0,(v t).2) satisfies the source unit condition.
code_level_construction.RHS: All high state terms are p(n+loss)0=0. Thus norm(J0i.D n (u,y)v)≤A. Enlarge to A*(1+p(n+loss)u+Σp(n+loss)(v t).1), whose parenthesis is at least1. This is Growth p 1 J0i base loss. Apply .withWeight W afterward.
code_level_construction.quantified_order: A may depend on i,n; it is independent of m, physical y, u and slots. There are only the fixed i=0,1,2 uses. base and loss remain unchanged and precede every n and radius.

code_level_construction.title: Restrict the public normalized increment towers.
code_level_construction.tower: For each i,m take the exact smoothDirectionsScalarPostcompose returned in the type of public199 and restrict it to U×V m. The inclusion uses only hl m and hh m, with hcell m unchanged.
code_level_construction.growth: Call hN.coefficientIncrement_normalized_joint_growth hS hT j hcell i. Introduce its R/n/constants and apply its bound at the enlarged-domain physical point. SmoothDirections.restrict.D is definitionally the same D. The original constants, base/loss and W are unchanged.
code_level_construction.value: The target function of this tower is di above by the public postcomposition definition, _root_.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply and smul_eq_mul. This is an actual function identity, not a new input assumption.
code_level_construction.sample_cost: No material endpoint bound, H lower bound, or private sample helper is called here.

code_level_construction.title: Use three actual products and two actual differences.
code_level_construction.bsum: Build JS := smoothDirectionsPostContinuousLinear (smoothDirectionsProd (J1) (J01)) (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ + ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ). Growth follows from .prodMk hp hW then .postLinear; its function is b+b0.
code_level_construction.output_orders: Each .mul call returns Bi,Li with base≤Bi, loss≤Bi. It does NOT assert loss≤Li. Set B=max B1 (max B2 B3) and L=max L1 (max L2 L3), and use .mono with the separate base and loss inequalities.
code_level_construction.differences: Define the actual T1−T2 and then (T1−T2)−T3 towers by smoothDirectionsProd followed by the continuous linear map fst−snd. After the common B/L enlargement, .sub hp hW supplies both estimates at that same B/L.
code_level_construction.tower_selection: All three product and two difference towers are defined before choosing their bounds. There is no order-dependent tower or new physical witness.

code_level_construction.title: Identify the literal normalized discriminant with a ring identity.
code_level_construction.exact_strategy: Expand only public project coefficientFamily, mixedDerivative at0, originalCoefficientEntry, and the own local aliases. iteratedDeriv_zero and ite_apply reduce the definition. For the three concrete Fin3 indices, simp/norm_num selects a,b,c. Rewrite div_eq_mul_inv and close by ring.
code_level_construction.no_division_assumption: This polynomial identity is valid with H⁻¹ treated as an arbitrary scalar, including H=0. No field_simp or H≠0 obligation is needed. Actual H>0 is already part of public199's proof, but is not an extra hypothesis or new cost.
code_level_construction.final_tower: Use .congrOn of the constructed difference tower to the fully literal function in the proposed public header. Use UniformWeightedJointGrowth.congr for the exact final K if necessary. Return this single K, then B,L and their already fixed bounds.
code_level_construction.state_zero: At u=0 the literal increment is0. This follows directly from liftSectorParameter_zero and sub_self, without another producer or extra public theorem.

quantifier_audit.target_order: Fix D/T/S/C,hN/hS/hT and the given j,l,h. Construct K once. Choose B,L once. Then ∀lowRadius≥0 ∀jointOrder n ∃A,Q≥0 ∀m/u/y/slots, the actual D bound holds.
quantifier_audit.stronger_than_required: This polynomial leaf has one common joint loss L before all n, rather than merely an order-dependent loss.
quantifier_audit.no_hidden_Bn: The only new low-base choices are the three fixed calls to public multiplication closure; none is inside the jointOrder/radius quantifiers.
quantifier_audit.how_spatial_cap_enters_later: For state order k and physical mixed order a+b≤s, jointOrder=k+a+b≤k+s. Monotonicity raises high k+a+b+L to s+(k+L). Thus a later per-k loss can be k+L while the low base B stays fixed. A separate mixed extraction/normalization still needs its actual theorem; this route does not claim the final CurrentJets inequality.
quantifier_audit.height_gain: K estimates normalized Δ/H with exactly H=T.H(T.sample(j m))^(3/4). Since H is a label-fixed scalar, returning to the unnormalized Δ multiplies every genuine D layer by the same H. No W power or constant is used to absorb that factor.

original_speed_boundary.checked_exact_object: minusCharacteristicSpeed (originalCoefficients D S C (liftSectorParameter S C u)) y
original_speed_boundary.excluded_object: minusCharacteristicSpeed (L.coefficients ...) is not the function in b95's public theorem.
original_speed_boundary.actual_buffer_instantiation: For the same153 j,x,δ choose l=x−δ and h=x+δ; its retained strict interior inequalities provide hl/hh. The actual closed-buffer a/Δ floor restricts to Ioo(l,h). Keep the identical j and physical point. Do not extend this floor to a complete root half.
original_speed_boundary.next_raw_forcing_formula: Let q=b−a*v and q0=b0−a0*v0. On this same positive buffer q=sqrtΔ and q0=sqrtΔ0. Then Graw/H = (v0*(δa/H) − δb/H + (δΔ/H)/(q+q0))/a.
original_speed_boundary.next_cost_inputs: Use the actual original-speed public tower and its fixed B/L growth, the same public coefficient towers, and the actual buffer lower bounds for a and q+q0; these are separate from this polynomial leaf.
original_speed_boundary.full_forcing: The same corrected153 field gives G=Graw−χ′ A Z. A and Z are the literal factors of the already established same-object returnCorrectionVelocity identity; Z carries the actual R.residual. No original-speed estimate is silently applied to corrected L, and no second residual or flow construction is selected.
original_speed_boundary.still_missing: The strong fixed-low-base high-parameter weighted bound for the actual same R.residual (and its contribution through the actual χ′ A Z operator) is not implemented. N02's genuine SmoothTameOn object alone does not provide that quantifier order. Completing Δ or Graw does not establish CurrentJets.
original_speed_boundary.definition_of_Graw: Graw := v0−v, the reference original minus speed minus the current original minus speed at the identical physical point.
